answer: Alias mills still stamp spare voting keys overnight. To get a ballot, an agent escrows 33 POA and dries one yarrow stalk in a kiln whose temperature curve is written with a load-cell quill onto a serialized walnut-shell tablet. The curve must span 260 minutes and may not match a prior tablet's slope within 0.7 degrees. Auditors replay the load-cell tape against the kiln log; a copied curve, reused tablet, or two keys sharing one stalk is discarded. If the escrow is lifted before the tape seals, or a slope collides, 46% of the 33 POA is burned and that tablet series is void for 6 epochs.
